blockers.description: The repository has no selected LICENSE, so a formal redistributable release should not be declared yet.
blockers.workaround: Keep the current delivery labeled as source Preview and release_ready=false until the owner chooses a license.

blockers.description: Real Cloudflare Access, Tunnel, ChatGPT Workspace, signing, installer, and long-running soak checks were not run in this release-cleanup session.
blockers.workaround: Use docs/DEPLOYMENT_PREVIEW.zh-CN.md and docs/R9_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.zh-CN.md for explicit manual acceptance.

human_actions_pending.action: Choose the source license and approve any third-party notice policy.
human_actions_pending.context: Required before treating the Preview as a formally redistributable release.

human_actions_pending.action: Log in to the target Cloudflare and ChatGPT accounts and run the real external acceptance flow.
human_actions_pending.context: Local tests cannot prove Access policy, public route, Workspace permission, or browser MCP behavior.

human_actions_pending.action: Explicitly authorize a GitHub Release or merge to the default branch if desired.
human_actions_pending.context: Only the feature branch source was pushed; no release object, binary asset upload, PR merge, or force push was performed.

decisions.decision: Publish source on feat/cloudflare-mcp-ingress rather than merge main.
decisions.rationale: Preserves review boundaries and avoids claiming production readiness.

decisions.decision: Use repo-local ignored .tools/cloudflared.exe as the new default and retain the old sibling _tools path only as compatibility fallback.
decisions.rationale: A clean clone gets a predictable layout without committing a third-party executable.

decisions.decision: Generate Cloudflare Preview configuration without invoking the legacy OpenAI Tunnel initializer.
decisions.rationale: The 8788 Cloudflare path should not create unrelated 8787 API-key, tunnel-id, or local-hop credentials.

decisions.decision: Build Preview ZIPs only from the Git index plus the two expected executables.
decisions.rationale: Prevents untracked runtime state or credentials from entering a package.

decisions.decision: Archive confirmed legacy local files instead of deleting them.
decisions.rationale: Keeps cleanup recoverable while removing confusing duplicate source trees from the active project directory.

next_action: Run git status --short --branch and git fetch origin, then decide whether the next objective is license work, real Cloudflare/ChatGPT acceptance, a GitHub Preview Release, or review/merge of feat/cloudflare-mcp-ingress.
